context: Asuka and Ren on the boy meeting strangers.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: film discussion; vocabulary (少年/従来/向かっ/小泉/他人/ものの) in natural home.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 少年は、旅に出るんですね。
lines.en: The boy sets out on a journey.
lines.style: engaged young man voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 不安なものの、前へ向かっていきます。
lines.en: Anxious though he is, he heads forward.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 従来の村を、出るんですか?
lines.en: Does he leave his conventional village?
lines.style: curious young man voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、従来の暮らしに別れを告げます。
lines.en: Yes, he bids farewell to conventional life.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 小泉政権の頃の、地方の話ですね。
lines.en: It's a rural tale from the Koizumi era.
lines.style: thoughtful young man voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 小泉氏の改革が、村にも届いた頃です。
lines.en: It's when Mr. Koizumi's reforms reached the village too.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 怖いものの、少年は進みますね。
lines.en: Scared though he is, the boy presses on.
lines.style: moved young man voice, soft warm reflective throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 夢に向かって、進む姿が美しいですね。
lines.en: His figure heading toward his dream is beautiful.
lines.style: warm teacher voice, soft warm measured closing clarity throughout
